pieces.doc: Region that opens its parent `[forContextMenu]` on the `contextmenu` event (right-click / long-press on touch) and on the keyboard equivalents `Shift+F10` and the dedicated `ContextMenu` key. Pointer activations are anchored at the cursor; keyboard activations are anchored at the bounding rect of the focused element, so screen-reader / keyboard-only users get the menu next to whatever they're working on. The native context menu is suppressed via `event.preventDefault()`.

Headless implementation of a right-click / `Shift+F10` menu (variant of the [WAI-ARIA Menu pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menubar/)). Apply on a wrapper that contains a `[forContextMenuTrigger]` and an `@if`-mounted `[forMenuContent]`.

inputs.name: side
inputs.doc: Side the menu is anchored to relative to the pointer. Defaults to `'bottom'`. Pair with `align` for the full positioning API.

inputs.name: align
inputs.doc: Alignment along the chosen `side`. Defaults to `'start'`.

inputs.name: sideOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the main axis. Default `0`. The default is read from `provideForContextMenuDefaults` for the surrounding scope.

inputs.name: alignOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the cross axis. Default `0`.

inputs.name: avoidCollisions
inputs.doc: When `true` (default), `flip` and `shift` keep the menu inside the viewport.

inputs.name: collisionPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) applied uniformly to flip / shift / size. Default `8`. The default is read from `provideForContextMenuDefaults` for the surrounding scope.

inputs.name: hideWhenDetached
inputs.doc: When `true`, sets `data-detached=""` while the virtual anchor is off-screen.

inputs.name: dir
inputs.doc: Writing direction. Drives ArrowLeft / ArrowRight semantics on submenu triggers and items underneath this menu (in RTL, ArrowLeft opens a submenu and ArrowRight closes it back). Default `'ltr'`.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, the contextmenu event is allowed to fall through to the native browser menu. Useful for letting the OS-provided context menu appear on certain regions while keeping the directive mounted.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnOpen
outputs.doc: Fires just before the menu sends focus to its first / last enabled item on mount. Call `preventDefault()` on the emitted veto to skip the imperative focus move.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnClose
outputs.doc: Fires just before focus returns to the trigger on unmount. Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to suppress the return-focus.

methods.name: setVirtualAnchor
methods.doc: Updates the virtual anchor to a 0×0 rect at (`x`, `y`) in viewport coordinates.

methods.name: setVirtualAnchorFromRect
methods.doc: Updates the virtual anchor to a snapshot of `rect`. Used by the keyboard activators (`Shift+F10`, `ContextMenu` key) so the menu floats off the focused element instead of the pointer position. The rect is captured by value, so subsequent layout changes don't shift the anchor.
